title: Yui — Chapter 1: Like
subtitle: Usne tumhari purani photo like ki thi…

lines: Notification aaya jab tum bistar pe lete the, aadhe soye, social media scroll kar rahe the.
Kisi ne tumhari ek purani photo like ki thi.
Naya post nahi. Kal wala nahi. Lagbhag teen mahine purani photo.
Curiosity hui, tumne notification pe tap kiya.
Account ek ladki ka tha — naam Yui.
Uska profile saaf aur quietly striking tha — university student, product brands ke liye part-time freelance model.
Skincare. Lifestyle. Kabhi-kabhi lingerie label. Professional nahi, lekin brands use baar-baar bulate the.
Uske paas aisa look tha — jo cheez bhi wo pakadti, wo chaahne layak lagti thi.
Wahi thi. Yui.
Sirf uski profile picture se tumhara scroll ruk gaya.
Zyadatar log ignore kar dete. Tumne nahi kiya.
Tumne uska profile khola. Paanch minute baad bhi tum scroll hi kar rahe the.
Phir tumne dekha — usne tumhara ek aur post like kiya tha. Aur purana. Lagbhag ek saal pehle ka.
Tum screen pe ghoorte rahe. Halki si muskaan. Tumne decide kiya — message karna hai.
Chat window khula.
Tum kaise shuru karna chahte ho?

choices.label: Likes ke liye thanks. Socha nahi tha koi profile itni gehraai tak jayega.
Lagta hai tumne sabse purani photo like karne ka record tod diya 😏

(Pehle message karne ki jagah uski ek photo like karo.)

Okay real talk — main usually aisa nahi karti 😅
Ek stranger ki ek saal purani photo like karna bilkul mujh pe nahi jata.
Lekin raat ho chuki hai, shehar shaant hai, aur tumhare baare mein kuch aisa tha jo mujhe actually hi kehne pe majboor kar gaya.

Safed camisole, patli straps, soft fit, neckline itni neeche ki uske chest ka curve dikh raha tha. Wo full-figured thi aise tareeke se jisko top chhupane ki koshish bhi nahi kar raha tha — cleavage pe roshni pad rahi thi, upper body frame pe raaj kar rahi thi, pehle uske alawa kuch nazar hi nahi aaya.
Mini skirt mid-thigh tak. Ek haath dheele se side pe, chin thodi neeche, nazar lens ke paar jaise pehle se asar pata ho aur usne hone diya ho.
Caption: *Naya brand, naya collab. Top aur skirt unke hain — confidence meri hai. 🌸*
